label: Q2 topk-jaccard stability (confirmatory)
methodNote: 台账记录的方法为 param-perturbation，被扰动的对象是冻结种子块；不得写成 multiple-seeds，也不得把两个执行块连同补充块写成 n=3 的计划结果

perturbations.name: frozen seed block repeat=1
perturbations.detail: the declared protocol constant SEEDS/repeat is changed from 0 to 1 (registered seed 20261026, 500 bootstrap replicates); everything else unchanged

perturbations.name: frozen seed block repeat=2
perturbations.detail: the declared protocol constant SEEDS/repeat is changed from 0 to 2 (registered seed 20261027, 500 bootstrap replicates)

decisionRule.reference: first linked experiment = the post-plan repeat-0 reference

dataUse.note: fixed 200-row SPLIT-0001 training set only; 50 held-out rows never used

scopeNote: MODEL-0050 / EXP-0125 reference; fixed 200-row train set, 50 test rows unused; two executed frozen seed blocks (repeat 0/1), 500 stratified bootstrap replicates each

supplementarySeedBlock.note: repeat-2 frozen seed block executed AFTER the plan was registered; NOT part of the ROB-0015 execution set and not merged into its values/spread/decision

newDefinition.definition: share of bootstrap replicates whose total-Spearman sign agrees with the POINT-ESTIMATE sign of the same (compound, dimension) cell

legacyDefinition.definition: superseded reading: share of bootstrap replicates with rho > 0, i.e. P(rho>0) — it penalises every cell whose point estimate is negative and must not be called 'sign stability'

directionCounts.note: counted over the delivered rows of the reference run; the legacy P(rho>0) reading is low because negative point estimates are penalised, not because the direction is unstable

signStability.legacyReproduction: 150/150 delivered consensus rows reproduce the legacy p_positive value exactly (see experiments/EXP-0107/sign_stability_summary.json legacyReproduction)
signStability.warning: any statement that quotes 0.7226 as 'sign stability' is describing the OLD denominator; the current definition is the agreement-with-point-estimate rate (0.9817)

limitations: topk-jaccard is between-method set agreement, NOT predictive accuracy
6.csv is same-source rank corroboration, not an external validation set
the executed plan has TWO linked blocks (repeat 0/1); the repeat-2 block was run after registration and is reported separately (supplementarySeedBlock), not merged
the ledger records the method as param-perturbation (the perturbed object is the frozen seed block); it is NOT a multiple-seeds plan
there is NO budget perturbation: bootstrap budget is 500 in every block
the bootstrap seed and the split repeat move together inside a seed block, so a seed effect and any residual split effect are not separately identified
sign stability is defined as agreement with the point estimate; the legacy P(rho>0) value is reported separately and is not interchangeable
